title: Metal carbonyls and synergic bonding
basic_overview: CO is a σ donor and π acceptor. Back-donation strengthens M–C and weakens C–O.

extra_info_content.short_trick: More backbonding → lower ν(CO) in IR.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. CO donates lone pair. 2. Metal d electrons back-donate into CO π*. 3. M–C strengthens. 4. C–O weakens. 5. IR shifts lower.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
